verdict.rationale:
Strong first-party evidence directly supports incremental adoption: official docs describe adding React to existing HTML pages/existing projects and rendering components anywhere, explicitly stating you can 'use as little or as much React as you need,' while also scaling up to full-stack frameworks like Next.js/React Router for entire apps. GitHub README reiterates the same 'as little or as much' framing and cross-platform scaling (web, server, native).

missing for 10: independent/hands-on case study demonstrating a real incremental migration rather than just first-party doc claims.
